title: Jazzy Monsoon Kenyan Haggis Skewers
description: A flavorful, herbal twist on traditional haggis, perfectly suited for a rainy day in Monsoon-affected Kenya. Pair with a refreshing hot-stone-plate serving experience.
instructions: Combine haggis, cilantro, dill, mint, ginger paste, garlic paste in a large bowl.
Mix well until all ingredients are evenly distributed.
Add lime juice, Kenyan honey, salt, and black pepper. Mix until just combined.
Heat a small amount of coconut oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Using skewers, thread 4-5 pieces of the haggis mixture onto each skewer.
Cook the skewers for 4 minutes per side, or until lightly browned.
Garnish with additional cilantro and dill if desired.
Serve with a side of your favorite Kenyan flatbread for dipping in the flavorful sauce.
Be sure to cook the skewers to an internal temperature of at least 165F (74C).
Repeat as needed for additional servings.
Keep leftovers refrigerated for up to 3 days.
Reheat by grilling for 1-2 minutes per side, or until lightly browned.
